notes: Printed page 167 (page number per manifest). Single-page table; the heading note says Part II is omitted from this volume. Area columns: col 2-4 = Calcutta with suburbs in 24-Parganas and Howrah City (total), 5-7 Calcutta, 8-10 Suburbs in 24-Parganas, 11-13 Howrah City. Only 71 language rows are printed (languages with no speakers in these areas are omitted). Language names kept as printed (e.g. 'Chhatrisgarhi', 'Telugu'). Checks: P = M + F for every cell; group totals equal sums of their languages; Hindustani/Bhotia/Kherwari equal their sub-entries; the total column equals Calcutta + Suburbs + Howrah City for every row and sex. Rajsthani 7,481/5,027/2,454 vs Marwari 7,474/5,021/2,453 in the total column (difference from Suburbs 0 and Howrah 82-75 etc.), consistent with the parts. Figures match Bengal vol. V Part B (leaf 201) for Suburbs and Howrah City and Part A Calcutta (leaf 194).
